label: dormwarssix10
title_zh: 咖啡师大乱斗：白人的复仇！

lines.en: label dormwarssix10:
scene baristawar1
: Haruka. You’re on.
lines.zh: : Haruka。该你了。

lines.en: scene baristawar2
: Oh...what? Really? I figured there’d be, like...an actual camera crew or something.
lines.zh: : 哦……什么？真的吗？我还以为会有……真正的摄制组什么的。

lines.en: : There is! But you can only see it if you believe. Kind of like Santa Claus.
lines.zh: : 有的！不过你只有相信才能看见。有点像圣诞老人。

lines.en: : {size=-2}I think it’s more like how the world looks more colorful when you’re young because your eyes slowly degrade over time. Or how you stop being able to hear certain sound frequencies as you get older and begin to die.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-2}我觉得更像小时候看世界更鲜艳——因为你的眼睛会随着时间慢慢退化。或者像你年纪越大、越接近死亡，就渐渐听不见某些频率的声音。{/size}

lines.en: : I think it’s like Santa Claus.
lines.zh: : 我觉得像圣诞老人。

lines.en: : Yeah, it’s probably like Santa Claus.
lines.zh: : 是啊，大概就像圣诞老人。

lines.en: : Can I start now or are you two not finished yet?
lines.zh: : 我可以开始了吗，还是你俩还没说完？

lines.en: : Can you make me a caramel macchiato, Work-Mom? I’m really tired after watching Molly try to be athletic.
lines.zh: : Work-Mom，能给我做杯焦糖玛奇朵吗？看 Molly 努力搞运动，我累坏了。

lines.en: : I would have won if the obstacle course was only one phase, Rin!
lines.zh: : 要是障碍赛道只有一个阶段，我早就赢了，Rin！

lines.en: : Okay, yeah. I’m just going to start.
lines.zh: : 好了，行。那我就开始了。

lines.en: scene baristawar3
if harukaspring1 == True:
: Welcome to Koi Cafe — a regular, law-abiding coffee shop established in 2018!
lines.zh: : 欢迎光临 Koi Cafe——一家创立于 2018 年的、守法经营的普通咖啡馆！

lines.en: else:
: Welcome to Koi Cafe — a local female-owned business started by myself, a female, in the year 2018!
lines.zh: : 欢迎光临 Koi Cafe——一家本地女性经营的店铺，由我本人——一位女性——于 2018 年创办！

lines.en: : Why...did you make it sound so suspicious?...
lines.zh: : 为什么……你说得听起来这么可疑？……

lines.en: : Don’t mind her, Sana. Haruka just be saying shit sometimes.
lines.zh: : 别理她，Sana。Haruka 有时候就是会瞎说。

lines.en: : I’m joined here today by two girls who have definitely {i}not{/i} been barista-certified, but will be allowed to use my equipment regardless because I think it will make for good publicity!
lines.zh: : 今天和我一起的是两位绝对{i}没有{/i}咖啡师认证的女生，但她们仍然可以用我的设备——因为我觉得这会是很好的宣传！

lines.en: scene baristawar4
: So please do not break my things! They were all very expensive and I am not done repaying my loans yet.
lines.zh: : 所以请别弄坏我的东西！它们都很贵，而我的贷款还没还完。

lines.en: : If...Molly can use these things without breaking them...I think we should be fine too...
lines.zh: : 如果……Molly 用这些东西都没弄坏的话……我觉得我们应该也没问题……

lines.en: : I want to take exception to this but, frankly, Zagull makes a good point.
lines.zh: : 我很想对此表示异议，不过说实话，Zagull 说得有道理。

lines.en: : So what do we have to do exactly? Just make drinks and shit?
lines.zh: : 那我们具体要做什么？就做饮料什么的？

lines.en: : Kind of. But the two of you will be serving {i}real-live{/i} customers today. So whoever makes it through a shift with the highest customer-satisfaction score wins.
lines.zh: : 算是吧。不过你们俩今天要服务{i}活生生的真人{/i}顾客。所以谁能在一个班次里拿到最高的顾客满意度，谁就赢。

lines.en: scene baristawar5
: Wait, we have to serve {i}actual{/i} people? I suck with customers. That’s why I got fired from Pepper Lunch.
lines.zh: : 等等，我们要服务{i}真的{/i}人？我最不会对付顾客了。我就是因为这个才被 Pepper Lunch 炒的。

lines.en: : Well, you can rest easy knowing that being fired today won’t matter at all in the grand scheme of things since this isn’t actually a real job!
lines.zh: : 不过你放心，今天就算被炒也完全无所谓，因为这本就不是一份真的工作！

lines.en: : Is there...anything else we should know?
lines.zh: : 还有……什么我们需要知道的吗？

lines.en: scene baristawar6
: Be more worried. Why am I the only one dreading this?
lines.zh: : 再担心点。为什么只有我一个人在害怕这个？

lines.en: : I mean...I kind of already do this for work. Just I make people drunk instead of...caffeinated.
lines.zh: : 我是说……我工作上差不多就在干这个。只不过我把人灌醉，而不是……灌咖啡因。

lines.en: : No hidden caveats. Just drinks. Except for one hidden caveat.
lines.zh: : 没有隐藏的附加条件。只有饮料。除了一个隐藏的附加条件。

lines.en: scene baristawar7
: But you just said-
lines.zh: : 可你刚才还说——

lines.en: : No I didn’t! Anyway, let me give you two a crash course on how to use everything before all the caveats come in.
lines.zh: : 我没有！总之，在那些附加条件杀到之前，我先给你们俩速成培训一下怎么用这些东西。

lines.en: scene baristawar8
: Wait, now there’s more than one?!
lines.zh: : 等等，现在不止一个了？！

lines.en: : What do you think the chances are of me being able to order a vanilla bean copyrighted frozen beverage right now?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我现在能点到一杯香草味的版权冷冻饮料的几率有多大？

lines.en: : Probably low on account of the cafe being closed for a special event. I could use a drink too, though.
lines.zh: : 大概很低，毕竟咖啡馆因为活动停业了。不过我也想来一杯。

lines.en: : Same. I was up last night having tons of sex with an idol.
lines.zh: : 我也是。我昨晚熬夜跟一个偶像做了很多次爱。

lines.en: scene baristawar9
: Wow. What a completely rude and insensitive thing to say to {i}both{/i} of us. Especially after {i}one{/i} of us dressed up like a cat and wore a tail-plug for you.
lines.zh: : 哇。这对我们{i}两个{/i}人来说都是极其无礼、毫无顾忌的一句话。尤其是我们{i}其中一个人{/i}还为你打扮成猫、戴了尾巴肛塞。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, what?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，你说什么？

lines.en: : I’m just trying to desensitize you for when you ultimately have to confront her, Maya. It’s going to happen sooner than you think now that she’s no longer clinging to the shadows.
lines.zh: : 我只是想让你脱敏，好在你最终不得不面对她的时候不至于崩溃，Maya。既然她已经不再躲在暗处，那一天会比你以为的来得更快。

lines.en: : I miss when {i}I{/i} got to cling to the shadows. This ridiculous gigolo arc has been extremely difficult to cope with.
lines.zh: : 我倒是怀念{i}我{/i}能躲在暗处的时候。这段荒唐的小白脸剧情实在太难熬了。

lines.en: : I really don’t want to just graze over this tail-plug thing.
lines.zh: : 我真不想就这么略过尾巴肛塞这件事。

lines.en: scene baristawar10
: Honestly, I forgot it was even there until Otoha started yanking on it.
lines.zh: : 说实话，在 Otoha 开始拽它之前，我都忘了那玩意儿还在里面。

lines.en: : Otoha? Is this another sex dream thing or am I just missing out on something here?
lines.zh: : Otoha？这又是一个性梦之类的东西，还是说我漏掉了什么？

lines.en: : Be glad you missed out, Ami. I don’t think you’d have handled that environment very well.
lines.zh: : 你错过是好事，Ami。我觉得那种场面你应付不来。

lines.en: : What do you mean? I’m famously good at handling anything and everything and have never broken down or lost sight of what’s important even once.
lines.zh: : 什么意思？我是出了名的什么都应付得来，从来没崩溃过，也从来没有一次迷失过重要的东西。

lines.en: : Yup. Sounds like Ami alright.
lines.zh: : 嗯。确实很 Ami。

lines.en: : Should I buy a tail-plug too? Will it make you love me more?
lines.zh: : 那我也该买个尾巴肛塞吗？这样你会更爱我吗？

lines.en: : Clearly not if he’s still going to have sex with {i}her{/i} over you.
lines.zh: : 显然不会——如果他还是会选{i}她{/i}而不是你上床的话。

lines.en: if amifingered == False:
: He doesn’t have sex with me at all. That’s why I’m so desperate.
lines.zh: : 他根本没跟我做过。所以我才这么不顾一切。

lines.en: else:
: Fair enough. He does have sex with me sometimes and I’m still desperate too. So I get it.
lines.zh: : 说得也是。他有时确实跟我做，可我一样不顾一切。所以我懂。

lines.en: : Please don’t buy a tail-plug, Ami. I have enough problems I already have to deal with at home.
lines.zh: : Ami，求你别买尾巴肛塞。我在家里要操心的问题已经够多了。

lines.en: if kirinchristmalloween1 == True:
scene baristawar11
: Hey, before we start...should we maybe talk about Christmalloween? I think there may have been some sort of...misunderstanding.
lines.zh: : 嘿，在开始之前……我们要不要聊聊圣诞万圣节的事？我觉得可能有点……误会。

lines.en: : A {i}misunderstanding?...{/i}

: Yeah. Like...there was no {i}wrongdoing{/i} or anything, right? I was just...{i}distracted{/i} and didn’t realize you weren’t exactly feeling it. Like, I obviously would have stopped if I really thought you wanted me to.
lines.zh: : 是啊。就是……并没有什么{i}做错{/i}的地方，对吧？我只是……{i}分心了{/i}，没意识到你其实并不想要。你看，如果真觉得你想让我停，我肯定会停的。

lines.en: : Okay. Guess we’ve talked about it then. Not much more to say.
lines.zh: : 好吧。那看来我们聊过了。没什么好说的了。

lines.en: : You haven’t, like...{i}told{/i} anyone, have you? Because it’d be really easy for someone to misinterpret the situation and that would, like...{i}not{/i} be good for me.
lines.zh: : 你没有……{i}告诉{/i}任何人吧？因为这种事很容易被人误解，那样对我{i}可不太好{/i}。

lines.en: : Ask your friend that walked in on it. Or her daughter, who could have stepped in but didn’t. I’m not going to tell people something I’m so ashamed of.
lines.zh: : 去问你那个撞见的朋友吧。或者问她女儿，她本可以阻止却没动手。我不会把一件让我这么羞耻的事说出去。

lines.en: : Ashamed? Why? What do you have to be ashamed of? I was the aggressor. {i}And{/i} I’m older than you. So if anyone should be ashamed, it’s me for not really...reading the room.
lines.zh: : 羞耻？为什么？你有什么可羞耻的？主动的是我。{i}而且{/i}我比你大。所以要说羞耻，那也该是我——因为我没能真正……读懂气氛。

lines.en: : A bathroom stall isn’t really much of a {i}room,{/i} though, is it?
lines.zh: : 可卫生间的隔间也算不上什么{i}房间{/i}吧？

lines.en: : Well, no...but-
lines.zh: : 嗯，不算……可是——

lines.en: : I’m not going to tell anyone, {i}Haruka.{/i} But I’d also appreciate it if you didn’t talk to me anymore. Like...at all.
lines.zh: : 我不会告诉任何人，{i}Haruka{/i}。不过我也希望你别再跟我说话了。就是……一句都别。

lines.en: : So just a...one-time thing then.
lines.zh: : 那就……只此一次了。

lines.en: : If that’s what you want to call it, sure.
lines.zh: : 如果你想这么叫的话，行。

lines.en: : Okay...guess I’ll just...leave you alone, then.
lines.zh: : 好吧……那我大概……就不打扰你了。

lines.en: : Cool. Thanks.
lines.zh: : 好。谢了。

lines.en: scene baristawar12
: You’re...{i}really{/i} sure you’re not going to tell anyone, right?
lines.zh: : 你……{i}真的{/i}确定不会告诉任何人，对吧？

lines.en: if sarasex == True:
scene baristawar13
: Uhh...Sara? Is everything okay?
lines.zh: : 呃……Sara？一切都还好吗？

lines.en: : No, Ayane. Everything is most certainly {i}not{/i} okay.
lines.zh: : 不，Ayane。一切绝对{i}一点都{/i}不好。

lines.en: if kirinchristmalloween1 == True:

: My daughter still wants to have a threesome with me, one of my best friends has cancer, and I recently caught a {i}different{/i} friend of mine potentially trying to take advantage of a teenage girl in a bathroom.
lines.zh: : 我女儿还想跟我搞三人行，我最好的朋友之一得了癌症，而且我最近还撞见{i}另一个{/i}朋友似乎在卫生间里试图占一个少女的便宜。

lines.en: else:
: My daughter still wants to have a threesome with me, one of my best friends has cancer, and I now have to wait another year for season three of The Pitt to find out what happens to Baby Jane Doe.
lines.zh: : 我女儿还想跟我搞三人行，我最好的朋友之一得了癌症，而且我现在还得再等一年才能等来《The Pitt》第三季，好知道 Baby Jane Doe 后来怎么样了。

lines.en: : So yeah. It’s all pretty fucking terrible.
lines.zh: : 所以是啊。一切都他妈糟透了。

lines.en: : Sana’s still...trying to get you to do that?
lines.zh: : Sana 还在……想让你做那件事？

lines.en: scene baristawar14
: I wouldn’t say she’s really {i}trying.{/i} It’s more like she’s just made up my mind {i}for{/i} me and there’s just nothing I can do to stop her.
lines.zh: : 我不会说她真的在{i}努力{/i}。更像是她已经替我把主意拿定了，而我拿她没办法。

lines.en: : Like, she tried to kiss {i}me{/i} the other day. No Sensei. Just the two of us. Alone in the bar. And she wanted to call it “practice” for the “real thing.”
lines.zh: : 比方说，前几天她试着亲了{i}我{/i}。没有 Sensei。就我们两个。在酒吧里独处。而她想把那叫做为「正戏」做的「练习」。

lines.en: : That...doesn’t really sound like Sana...
lines.zh: : 那……听起来不太像 Sana……

lines.en: scene baristawar15

: That’s what I thought! But if it’s happening all the time now, maybe it {i}is{/i} like her?! Like, maybe she’s just taking our genetic horniness up a level and being even weirder about it than I am?!
lines.zh: : 我就是这么想的！可如果现在这种事一直发生，也许她{i}真的{/i}就是这样了？！比如说，也许她只是把我们家遗传的性欲往上提了一级，表现得比我还怪？！

lines.en: : Do you...want me to talk to her, maybe? Sana listens to me. And if I can get through to her about this, maybe you guys can-
lines.zh: : 你……想让我去跟她谈谈吗？Sana 听我的。如果我能让她想通这件事，也许你们就能——

lines.en: scene baristawar16
: No, Ayane. I don’t want you to {i}talk{/i} to my daughter about her unusual perversions. That’s something {i}I’m{/i} supposed to handle, if anyone.
lines.zh: : 不，Ayane。我不想让你去{i}谈{/i}我女儿那些不寻常的癖好。那件事该由{i}我{/i}来处理，如果说该有人的话。

lines.en: : But at this rate, I’ve more or less just resigned myself to the fact that it’s going to happen regardless of how I feel and that fighting it won’t do anything but push her away.
lines.zh: : 可照这个势头，我基本上已经认命了——不管我怎么想，它都会发生，而反抗除了把她推远之外什么也做不到。

lines.en: : Well...maybe pushing her away is what needs to happen if you want to stay true to yourself and be happy with who {i}you{/i} are as a person, Sara?
lines.zh: : 那个……也许你需要的就是把她推开——如果你想忠于自己、并接受{i}你{/i}这个人的话，Sara？

lines.en: : Having a child means being willing to sacrifice your happiness for their sake. And if this is what Sana really thinks she needs to be happy, I can...{i}suffer{/i} for that.
lines.zh: : 有一个孩子，就意味着愿意为了她牺牲自己的幸福。如果 Sana 真的觉得这样她才能幸福，那我可以……为她{i}受苦{/i}。

lines.en: : There needs to be a line, though...right? Like, I understand the point of sacrificing your own happiness for someone you love, but there comes a point where the trade-off is just super imbalanced, don’t you think?
lines.zh: : 可总得有条底线吧……对吧？我是说，我理解为你爱的人牺牲自己的幸福，可总有一个点，那种交换会变得极不平衡，你不觉得吗？

lines.en: : Maybe “sacrificing your happiness” isn’t how I should have put it. Like...I don’t know. It’s not going to be the end of the world or anything when it happens. It’s just {i}wrong.{/i}
lines.zh: : 也许「牺牲幸福」不是我该用的说法。就是……我不知道。真发生了也不会是世界末日什么的。只是那{i}不对{/i}。

lines.en: : And I {i}know{/i} it’s wrong. But so is letting her drink. And so is turning a blind eye to what she does with Sensei. And so is forcing her to work at a bar that I can’t handle on my own.
lines.zh: : 而我{i}知道{/i}那不对。可让她喝酒也不对。对她和 Sensei 之间发生的事睁一只眼闭一只眼也不对。逼她在我一个人撑不起来的酒吧里干活还是不对。

lines.en: : So what right do I have to deny her of something {i}she{/i} wants that just {i}also{/i} happens to be wrong? After I’ve forced so much...{i}incorrectness{/i} into her life already?
lines.zh: : 那我凭什么去拒绝{i}她{/i}想要、又{i}恰好{/i}是错的某件事？在我已经往她的人生里塞了那么多……{i}不正确的东西{/i}之后？

lines.en: : I don’t know. I imagine it’s hard to understand when you don’t have a daughter of your own. But I love her so deeply that I would do anything she wants because I’m afraid of a world where she doesn’t love me back.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。我想，没有女儿的人大概很难理解。可我爱她爱得那么深，她想要什么我都愿意做，因为我害怕她不再爱我的那个世界。

lines.en: scene baristawar17
: I get what you mean...
lines.zh: : 我懂你的意思……

lines.en: : I’m just...sorry.
lines.zh: : 我只是……很抱歉。

lines.en: : That Sana’s put you into such a...terrible situation.
lines.zh: : 很抱歉 Sana 把你逼进了这么……糟糕的境地。

lines.en: : She’s only putting me into this situation at all because I fucked up somewhere down the line. Could’ve been anywhere really. It’s happened so many times.
lines.zh: : 她之所以会把我逼到这一步，全是因为我在哪里搞砸了。真的可能是任何地方。这种事发生了太多次。

lines.en: : But if I’d only raised her better...done something different...she wouldn’t be like this. So it’s like I’ve made my bed and now I have to lie in it. Or, in this case, I’ve made my daughter and now I have to lie {i}with{/i} her.
lines.zh: : 可如果我当初把她教得更好一点……做了什么不同的事……她就不会是现在这样。所以就像自作自受，现在得自己承受。或者说，在这个情况下，我造出了我的女儿，现在就得跟她{i}一起躺{/i}。

lines.en: : And probably get shown up in the process because she’s tiny and cute and excited at the prospect of exploring a new world while I’m just a few more years away from having back problems.
lines.zh: : 而且大概还会被比下去——因为她娇小、可爱，对探索新世界充满期待，而我再过几年就要有腰疼的毛病了。

lines.en: : I’m sorry for venting like this, Ayane. Just...nobody else knows yet. And you’ve obviously become like another daughter to me. I just hope it doesn’t sound like I’m bitching about your little sister.
lines.zh: : 抱歉跟你倒这些苦水，Ayane。只是……还没有别人知道。而你显然已经成了我的另一个女儿。我只希望这听起来不像是在抱怨你妹妹。

lines.en: : It doesn’t...don’t worry.
lines.zh: : 没有……别担心。

lines.en: : You know...
lines.zh: : 你知道吗……

lines.en: : I’ve been having this...{i}weird dream{/i} lately.
lines.zh: : 我最近一直做这个……{i}奇怪的梦{/i}。

lines.en: scene baristawar18
: The caveats are here! Bring in the white people and let the contest begin!
lines.zh: : 附加条件到了！把白人带进来，比赛开始！

lines.en: : Quick, somebody hide Otoha.
lines.zh: : 快，谁去把 Otoha 藏起来。

lines.en: scene baristawar19
: Wha-?!
: SWEEEEEEET CAAAAROLIIIIIINE ~ BUM BUM BUM! GOOD TIIIIMES NEEEVER SEEMED SO GOOD!
lines.zh: : 甜蜜的卡罗琳咿咿咿～蹦 蹦 蹦！好时光从未如此美好！

lines.en: : SO GOOD! SO GOOD! SO GOOD!
lines.zh: : 这么美好！这么美好！这么美好！

lines.en: : What is this strange and seemingly ritualistic song they’re singing?! NO ENGLISH. CAN’T SPEAK. JAPANESE ONLY.
lines.zh: : 他们唱的这首奇怪又像仪式的歌是什么？！没有英语。不会说。只能用日语。

lines.en: : Hello. Nice to meet you. My name is Sana.
lines.zh: : 你好。很高兴认识你。我叫 Sana。

lines.en: : すごい！英語上手ですね！
lines.zh: : すごい！英語上手ですね！

lines.en: scene baristawar20
: That one’s an impostor! He can clearly speak Japanese!
lines.zh: : 那家伙是冒牌货！他明明会说日语！

lines.en: : ありがとうございます。ご注文は？
lines.zh: : ありがとうございます。ご注文は？

lines.en: : I don’t know any other Japanese words.
lines.zh: : 我别的日语单词都不会。

lines.en: : I still don’t understand why those were the only ones you chose to learn in the first place.
lines.zh: : 我还是不明白，你当初为什么偏偏就只学了这么几句。

lines.en: : IIIII’VE BEEN INCLINED ~ BUM BUM BUM! TO BELIEVE THEY NEVER WOOOOOULD-
lines.zh: : 我iiii一直倾向于～蹦 蹦 蹦！相信它们永远不会——

lines.en: scene baristawar21
: Stop your singing and read the sign! Japanese only!
lines.zh: : 别唱了，看牌子！只能用日语！

lines.en: : I think the sign says that English is okay.
lines.zh: : 我觉得牌子上写着英语也行。

lines.en: scene baristawar22
: Wow! If only I COULD FUCKING READ IT!!!
lines.zh: : 哇！要是我他妈看得懂就好了！！！

lines.en: scene baristawar23
: Are you sure you don’t want me to help them?
lines.zh: : 你确定不要我帮帮她们吗？

lines.en: : No, it’s fine. Your other teacher was pretty insistent on throwing them a curveball.
lines.zh: : 不，没关系。你们的另一位老师挺坚持要给她们来个出其不意的。

lines.en: : Plus, immersive learning experiences like this will make for good experience once Japan opens back up and they have to regularly communicate with tourists.
lines.zh: : 再说，等日本重新开放、她们得经常跟游客交流时，这种沉浸式学习体验会是很宝贵的经验。

lines.en: if harukasex == True:
: You mean when your husband returns from space to find out that you’ve been getting bent over his side of the bed by another man?
lines.zh: : 你是说等你丈夫从太空回来，发现你一直在他那半边床上被另一个男人弯腰压着？

lines.en: scene baristawar24
: Thank you, Molly. That is something I definitely wanted to be thinking about right now.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你啊，Molly。这绝对是我现在特别想琢磨的事。

lines.en: : Which hero will you side with, I wonder? The man you already {i}chose?{/i} Or the {i}chosen one{/i} himself?
lines.zh: : 我倒想知道，你会站哪一位英雄那边？是你早已{i}选择{/i}的那个男人？还是{i}天选之子{/i}本人？

lines.en: : Being the chosen one would certainly explain why Sensei is able to sleep with virtually all of you without ever incurring any consequences, yeah.
lines.zh: : 如果他是天选之子，倒确实能解释为什么 Sensei 跟你们几乎所有人都上过床，却从来没承担过任何后果。

lines.en: : There are consequences aplenty, Magistrate. I can only imagine how difficult it must be for him to sort through thousands of CGs just to find the sex scene he’s trying to recollect.
lines.zh: : 后果多得很呢，法官大人。我能想象，他要在几千张 CG 里翻找、只为找回他想回忆的那场性爱场面，该有多困难。

lines.en: : Besides! Maybe your husband is one of those weird people who actually {i}likes{/i} NTR?
lines.zh: : 再说了！也许你丈夫就是那种真的{i}喜欢{/i} NTR 的怪人呢？

lines.en: scene baristawar25
: Or maybe he will be unable to cope with the thought of his beloved being claimed by another while he was off protecting our country from aliens? One can do naught but wonder...
lines.zh: : 又或者，他无法承受这样的念头——他在外保护我们的国家免受外星人侵害时，心爱的人却被另一个人占有？人们只能猜想了……

lines.en: : If either of the two girls up there are good at this, I’m hiring one of them to replace you.
lines.zh: : 要是上面那两个女生有谁干得不错，我就雇一个来顶替你。

lines.en: scene baristawar26
: Please don’t. This is where I get my gacha money.
lines.zh: : 别啊。我抽卡的钱就是从这儿来的。

lines.en: else:

: {size=-3}You mean when your husband returns from space that you’ve somehow, almost miraculously, managed to avoid an easily accessible sexual relationship with a very attractive man that has vaginally penetrated basically everyone else you know?{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-3}你是说等你丈夫从太空回来时，你会以一种几乎堪称奇迹的方式，成功躲开一段唾手可得的性关系——对方是一个极具魅力的男人，而且基本上把你认识的每个人都阴道侵入过了？{/size}

lines.en: scene baristawar27
: Right. And if he does not have copious amounts of sex with me upon his return, I am probably going to just kill him and then myself because this has been extraordinarily difficult.
lines.zh: : 对。如果他回来之后不跟我做大量的爱，我大概会先杀了他再自杀，因为这实在太难熬了。

lines.en: : You are stronger than most, Magistrate. But your loyalty will not go unnoticed by those who are viewing these events from the safety of their own bedrooms right now.
lines.zh: : 你比大多数人都坚强，法官大人。不过此刻正窝在自己卧室里安全地看着这些事的人，不会看不见你的忠诚。

lines.en: : Do you think they got an option to view a route where I {i}did{/i} wind up cheating on my husband?
lines.zh: : 你觉得他们有没有选项，能看到我{i}真的{/i}出轨了丈夫的那条路线？

lines.en: : I imagine they did, yes. Married woman make exceptional targets for those looking to virtually power trip.
lines.zh: : 我想有吧，是的。对于那些想在虚拟世界里体验掌控感的人来说，已婚女性是绝佳的目标。

lines.en: : How do you think that route is compared to the one {i}I{/i} chose?
lines.zh: : 你觉得那条路线跟我{i}选的{/i}这条比起来怎么样？

lines.en: : Speaking from experience, much better.
lines.zh: : 凭经验说，好太多了。

lines.en: scene baristawar28
: Aww man...really?
lines.zh: : 哎呀……真的吗？

lines.en: : I truly do believe that the Supreme Overlord’s penis has been blessed by one of the old gods. But that could just be any penis. I don’t know. I’ve only ever had one inside of me. But it was great.
lines.zh: : 我真心相信至高霸主的那根阴茎被某位古神祝福过。不过也许任何阴茎都这样。我不知道。我这辈子只被一根进去过。不过那感觉很棒。

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m sure it was...
lines.zh: : 是啊，肯定很棒……

lines.en: : Don’t be too sure, though. Someone will call it NTR and say thought-crimes are still crimes.
lines.zh: : 不过也别太肯定。总会有人管这叫 NTR，还说思想罪也是罪。

lines.en: : Molly, I hope you know that if either of the two girls up there are good at this, I’m hiring one of them to replace you.
lines.zh: : Molly，你最好明白：要是上面那两个女生有谁干得不错，我就雇一个来顶替你。

lines.en: : Please don’t. This is where I get my gacha money.
lines.zh: : 别啊。我抽卡的钱就是从这儿来的。

lines.en: scene baristawar29
: Okay, okay! I can only make one at a time, people! JUST ONE. PLEASE WAIT.
lines.zh: : 好了好了！我一次只能做一杯，各位！就一杯。请稍等。

lines.en: : First off, if you’re only making one drink at a time in a fast paced environment like this, you’re never going to last. Second, we’re not really supposed to yell at customers no matter how badly we may want to.
lines.zh: : 首先，在这种快节奏的环境里一次只做一杯，你是不可能撑下去的。其次，不管我们多想冲顾客吼，也不该那么做。

lines.en: scene baristawar30
: Why not? It’s not like these ones can understand what I’m saying.
lines.zh: : 为什么不？反正这些人又听不懂我在说什么。

lines.en: : No, but they can understand your tone. And someone in the store might also take offense to seeing how you treat them and think about taking their business somewhere else.
lines.zh: : 是听不懂，可他们听得懂你的语气。而且店里可能还有别人，看到你这么对待他们会觉得不舒服，然后考虑以后去别家消费。

lines.en: : The fuck are you even helping me for? Shouldn’t you be giving Sana advice or something since she’s actually on your team?
lines.zh: : 你他妈干嘛要帮我啊？Sana 才是你们队的人，你不是该去给她出主意什么的吗？

lines.en: : I’m mostly just hanging around to make sure you don’t break anything. And Sana’s doing fine, so I don’t really need to help her anyway.
lines.zh: : 我主要是待在这儿确保你别弄坏东西。而 Sana 干得挺好，所以我其实也不用帮她。

lines.en: : One...caramel...frozen copyrighted beverage. Okay.
lines.zh: : 一杯……焦糖……版权冷冻饮料。好的。

lines.en: scene baristawar31
: Could you tell me what type of sugar you use for that? And also what type of milk?
lines.zh: : 能告诉我你用的是哪种糖吗？还有哪种奶？

lines.en: : Sugar, yes. This drink is sugar.
lines.zh: : 糖，对。这杯饮料就是糖。

lines.en: : Still a bit of a language barrier, though.
lines.zh: : 不过还是有语言障碍。

lines.en: scene baristawar32
: How...pay?
lines.zh: : 怎么……付钱？

lines.en: : I’ll use my credit card.
lines.zh: : 我用信用卡。

lines.en: : Huh?
: Uhh...creditto? Kudasai?
lines.zh: : 呃……creditto？Kudasai？

lines.en: : I’m sorry. I don’t understand.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我不明白。

lines.en: : Still sure she doesn’t need any help?
lines.zh: : 你还是确信她不需要帮忙吗？

lines.en: : She’ll figure it out. We all have to.
lines.zh: : 她会搞明白的。我们都得靠自己。

lines.en: scene baristawar33
: C...Card! Credit card!
lines.zh: : 信……信用卡！信用卡！

lines.en: : Rin, please help break her out of that Gen Z stare thing you girls are always doing now so the next person can order.
lines.zh: : Rin，麻烦帮她从你们这些姑娘现在动不动就犯的 Z 世代呆滞凝视里回过神来，好让下一位点单。

lines.en: : カードで、小菜ちゃん。
lines.zh: : カードで、小菜ちゃん。

lines.en: scene baristawar34
: ああはい。わかりました。Please tap. Thank you business.
lines.zh: : ああはい。わかりました。Please tap. Thank you business.

lines.en: : When do I get a turn on the register? That seems way easier than trying to figure out how to work this espresso machine thing. I can’t even get this fucking handle off.
lines.zh: : 什么时候轮到我用收银机？那看起来比弄明白这台浓缩咖啡机怎么用容易多了。我连这该死的把手都拆不下来。

lines.en: scene baristawar35
: That’s actually called a portafilter. It-
lines.zh: : 那玩意儿其实叫手柄过滤器。它——

lines.en: : Sana! Switch places with me!
lines.zh: : Sana！跟我换个位置！

lines.en: : Okay, yeah. I’ll just go fuck myself.
lines.zh: : 好，行。那我就去操我自己吧。

lines.en: scene baristawar36
: Okay. So, the first thing you’re going to want to do is-
lines.zh: : 好的。那么，你首先要做的是——

lines.en: : I...think I get it. We...have one of these at the bar. It’s just...much smaller.
lines.zh: : 我……好像明白了。我们……酒吧里也有一台这个。只是……小得多。

lines.en: : You have a steaming wand too? Or is it one of those smaller ones with a frother instead, like we have in the dorm?
lines.zh: : 你们也有蒸汽棒吗？还是那种小一点的、用打泡器代替的，就像我们宿舍里的那种？

lines.en: : I...uhh...is there a difference?
lines.zh: : 我……呃……这有区别吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, I’ll show you. With steaming wands, you-
lines.zh: : 有，我演示给你看。用蒸汽棒的话，你——

lines.en: : Order please. You speak.
lines.zh: : 请点单。你说。

lines.en: : O...Osu...sumay wa...na...nani...desu ka?
lines.zh: : O……Osu……sumay wa……na……nani……desu ka？

lines.en: ki" おすすめ？Coffee."
lines.zh: ki" おすすめ？Coffee."

lines.en: : Regular coffee?
lines.zh: : 普通咖啡？

lines.en: : Regular coffee.
lines.zh: : 普通咖啡。

lines.en: : Okay...
lines.zh: : 好的……

lines.en: : I’ll have an upside down, non-fat, whole milk, extra hot iced chai with nine pumps of raspberry, two packets of this sugar I brought from home, chocolate whipped cream, and a caramel drizzle.
lines.zh: : 我要一杯倒置、脱脂、全脂牛奶、特热的冰印度拉茶，加九泵树莓糖浆、两包我从家带来的糖、巧克力奶油，再淋上焦糖酱。

lines.en: : But if you could do the crosshatch pattern on top of the whipped cream like you’d do with a caramel macchiato in addition to the drizzle inside of the cup, that would be great. Also, I have a coupon.
lines.zh: : 不过如果你能在奶油上做出焦糖玛奇朵那种交叉网格花纹，再加上杯内的焦糖淋酱，那就太好了。另外，我有优惠券。

lines.en: : Want me to spit in it too?
lines.zh: : 要不要我再往里面吐口痰？

lines.en: : Please don’t spit in his drink, Kirin. It’s bad enough as is.
lines.zh: : Kirin，别往他饮料里吐痰。光是这样就够糟了。

lines.en: : Um...on...onegaishimasu?
lines.zh: : 呃……on……onegaishimasu？

lines.en: scene baristawar37
: I don’t know. Sounds like he wants me to spit in it.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。听起来他好像想让我往里面吐痰。

lines.en: : They just say お願いします or 大丈夫です to basically every single question during checkout and hope for the best. I don’t think he actually wants you to spit in the drink.
lines.zh: : 他们在结账时基本对每个问题都只说 お願いします 或 大丈夫です，然后听天由命。我觉得他其实不是真想让你往饮料里吐痰。

lines.en: : Please...spit in my drink.
lines.zh: : 请……往我的饮料里吐痰。

lines.en: scene baristawar38
: Oh...or he’s one of {i}those.{/i}
lines.zh: : 哦……或者他是{i}那种人{/i}。

lines.en: : はい！かしこまりました！お支払方法はどうされますか？カードで？現金？君わかりますか？
lines.zh: : はい！かしこまりました！お支払方法はどうされますか？カードで？現金？君わかりますか？

lines.en: : Uhh...onegaishimasu?
lines.zh: : 呃……onegaishimasu？

lines.en: scene baristawar39
: Give me your fucking credit card or I will grind you into dust and put {i}you{/i} inside the fucking {i}portafilter.{/i}
lines.zh: : 把你那该死的信用卡给我，不然我就把你磨成灰，塞进那该死的{i}手柄过滤器{/i}里。

lines.en: : Dude, I think she likes you.
lines.zh: : 兄弟，我觉得她喜欢你。

lines.en: : Right? It totally feels that way.
lines.zh: : 对吧？感觉完全就是这么回事。

lines.en: scene baristawar40
: Okay! So Kirin is fired. And Koi Cafe does {i}not{/i} endorse or support the unfair treatment of foreigners, including but not limited to insulting and/or pouring hot beverages on them.
lines.zh: : 好了！那么 Kirin 被开除了。而 Koi Cafe {i}绝{/i}不认可或支持对外国人的不公平对待，包括但不限于侮辱他们和／或把热饮浇在他们身上。

lines.en: : It was {i}iced.{/i}
lines.zh: : 那是{i}冰的{/i}。

lines.en: : I think technically he...said iced and...extra hot, so...I’m not really sure what that makes the drink...
lines.zh: : 我觉得严格来说他……说了冰的又……说了特热，所以……我真不确定那到底算什么饮料……

lines.en: : Which is a totally reasonable thing to think! But here at Koi Cafe, the customer is always right. Even when they’re wrong. So sometimes, you just need to let them think they’re doing a good job.
lines.zh: : 这想法完全合理！不过在 Koi Cafe，顾客永远是对的。哪怕他们错了。所以有时候，你只需要让他们觉得自己干得不错就行。

lines.en: scene baristawar41
: That said, it goes without question that the winner here today is Sana. And that she’s welcome to actually work here whenever she wants since that really wasn’t all that bad for a first time.
lines.zh: : 话虽如此，毫无疑问今天的赢家是 Sana。而且我们随时欢迎她来这儿上班——作为第一次，她表现得真不算差。

lines.en: : I...appreciate that...but I don’t think my mom would like the idea of you...poaching me from the bar very much...
lines.zh: : 我……很感谢……不过我觉得我妈妈不会太喜欢你……从酒吧挖我这个主意……

lines.en: : That’s fine. She can have Kirin. You guys already have Yuki and people apparently love it when she’s mean to them over there.
lines.zh: : 没关系。Kirin 可以让给她。你们那儿已经有 Yuki 了，而且大家显然很喜欢她对他们凶巴巴的样子。

lines.en: : I may have lost, but today was surprisingly therapeutic. I’m not opposed to doing it again.
lines.zh: : 我虽然输了，不过今天出奇地治愈。我不排斥再来一次。

lines.en: : I will...relay the message...
lines.zh: : 我会……转达的……

lines.en: scene baristawar42
: Well, thankfully, you won’t need to wait very long to do that! Because the tenth and final contest of this year’s Dorm Wars will once again be taking place at Sakaki-bar-a!
lines.zh: : 好吧，幸好你不用等太久！因为今年宿舍战争第十场、也是最后一场比赛，将再次在 Sakaki-bar-a 举行！

lines.en: : But before you go, remember to shop at Koi Cafe! Where we’ll spit in {i}any{/i} drink so long as you pay us enough!
lines.zh: : 不过在走之前，记得光顾 Koi Cafe！只要你给够钱，我们往{i}任何{/i}饮料里吐痰都行！

lines.en: : Wait, I never signed up for that!
lines.zh: : 等等，我可从没答应过这个啊！
